case.question: Where should I check the current IBM Cloud CLI installation instructions?
case.expected_answer: Point to official IBM Cloud CLI installation documentation. Do not invent current version numbers or installation details absent from evidence.

response.answer: You can find the current IBM Cloud CLI installation instructions by accessing the official `ibm-cloud-cli-releases` GitHub repository. From there, you can select the installer that corresponds to your operating system to begin the download. Supported operating systems include macOS X 64-bit, Windows™ 64-bit, Linux™ x86 64-bit, and Linux™ LE 64-bit (ppc64le). After downloading, run the installer and add `{YOUR_DIRECTORY}/IBM_CLOUD_CLI` to your `PATH` environment variable.

Use the following steps to install the latest stand-alone IBM Cloud CLI:

1. Use a browser to access the official `ibm-cloud-cli-releases` (opens in a new tab) GitHub repository, and select the installer of your OS to begin the download.
   The following operating systems are supported: macOS X 64-bit, Windows™ 64-bit, Linux™ x86 64-bit, and Linux™ LE 64-bit (ppc64le).
2. Run the installer: [...] Add the `{YOUR_DIRECTORY}/IBM_CLOUD_CLI` to the `PATH` environment variable.
    For shell autocompletion support (Mac and Linux™ only), see Enabling shell autocompletion for IBM Cloud CLI.

## Updating the IBM Cloud CLI

Use the latest version of the CLI. If you aren't using the latest version, run the following command to update your CLI:

```

ibmcloud update

```

To determine your IBM Cloud CLI version, run the following command:

```

ibmcloud -v

``` [...] ibmcloud -v

```

No update required. Your CLI is already up-to-date.

```

## ibmcloud config

Writes default values to the configuration file.

```

ibmcloud config --http-timeout TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS | --trace (true|false|path/to/file) |
         --color (true|false) | --locale (LOCALE|CLEAR) | --check-version (true|false)

```
